ADM-012.scenario: Full review decision path completes with actions visible
steps: Open /hub/work
Open a pending submission
Inspect evidence media
Choose confidence and enter feedback
Verify Approve and Reject are visible in the pinned dialog action region without scrolling
Reject or approve
Confirm the queue updates
ADM-012.expected: The complete decision path works and commit/cancel actions are never hidden inside a clipped scrolling region

ADM-013.scenario: Commitment confirmation states who and what before commit
steps: Open /hub/confirm
Open a commitment
Verify who and what is affected is stated
Confirm or decline
Reopen after an external change to exercise stale data
ADM-013.expected: Consequences are named before the act, stale data is handled honestly, and the resulting state is visible

ADM-014.scenario: Pool console statuses, seeding, and detail are coherent
steps: Open /garden/pool
Inspect funding and readiness status
Open /garden/pool/seed and review before any commit
Open a commitment detail
Cancel out safely
ADM-014.expected: Statuses are honest, destructive/chain actions are gated behind review, and cancel preserves state

ADM-026.scenario: Seed a commitment: 4-step wizard, named confirmers, review, queued creation
steps: Run the 4-step seed wizard
Add named confirmers incl. one bad address
Review, queue, and watch the queued row
ADM-026.expected: Beats validate; a bad/duplicate confirmer address is rejected visibly (currently a silent no-op); review precedes queueing; the queued row appears before the indexer catches up

ADM-037.scenario: Record a starting assessment for the test Garden
steps: Select the test Garden and start a new assessment
Record the Garden's starting context with enough detail for Tester B to recognize it
Review and submit the assessment
Wait for the submitted assessment to appear on the Garden
ADM-037.expected: The assessment is recorded against the test Garden and is visible as starting context, without being described as a prerequisite for opening a Season or Campaign

PWA-046.scenario: Garden member can read the starting assessment
steps: Open the test Garden
Open its assessment history
Find the starting assessment recorded by Tester A
Read enough detail to confirm it belongs to this QA cycle
PWA-046.expected: The same starting assessment is readable from the Garden experience and is presented as context, not as a gate on the cycle

ADM-038.scenario: Open the test Season and Campaign independently of assessment state
steps: Open the test Garden's pool setup
Create or select the QA Season
Open one Campaign for the commitment relay
Confirm the open cycle is visible before seeding commitments
ADM-038.expected: The Season and Campaign open successfully whether or not the starting assessment has finished indexing; the assessment remains contextual

ADM-039.scenario: Seed an approval-gated protocol Request for a concrete service
steps: Open the Green Goods protocol pool
Seed a Request that names a concrete service and clear evidence
Require approval before a claimant is accepted
Review and submit the Request
Wait for the Request to appear in the protocol pool
ADM-039.expected: One approval-gated Request appears in the protocol pool with its service, evidence, and confirmation expectations intact

PWA-047.scenario: Claim the protocol Request for the test Garden
steps: Open the protocol Request
Choose to take it up for the test Garden
Review the Garden identity and submit the claim
Wait for the claim to show as pending approval
PWA-047.expected: The claim is pending for the test Garden; it is not presented as a personal claim and the Request has not moved out of the protocol pool

ADM-040.scenario: Accept the test Garden's institutional claim
steps: Open pending claims for the protocol Request
Identify the claim from the test Garden
Accept the Garden claim
Reopen the Request after the state updates
ADM-040.expected: The claim becomes Accepted, the Garden is the institutional provider, and the original Request remains in the protocol pool

PWA-048.scenario: Submit Work and evidence against the original protocol Request
steps: Open the Accepted protocol Request
Start or link the Work completed for the service
Add clear evidence from Tester B
Submit the Work
Return to the Request and verify the Work is linked
PWA-048.expected: Tester B's Work and evidence link to the original protocol-pool Request while the test Garden remains the accountable provider

ADM-041.scenario: Approve Work linked to the protocol Request without joining its contributors
steps: Open the pending Work linked to the protocol Request
Inspect Tester B's evidence and Garden context
Approve the Work
Verify the review state updates without adding Tester A as a contributor
ADM-041.expected: The linked Work is approved by an independent reviewer and Tester A remains outside the contributor roster

ADM-042.scenario: Confirm the protocol Request after its Work is approved
steps: Open the protocol Request awaiting confirmation
Verify the approved Work and evidence are named
Confirm fulfillment as the Request creator
Reopen the Request after the state updates
ADM-042.expected: The Request becomes Fulfilled with the test Garden still named as provider and Tester B's Work preserved as evidence

ADM-043.scenario: Settle earned G$ compensation from the protocol to the Garden
steps: Open the Fulfilled protocol Request's settlement action
Verify the beneficiary is the destination Garden Safe
If settlement UI and value authority are available, review and submit the payout
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the destination state
ADM-043.expected: When enabled, earned compensation targets the Garden Safe and the result is visible; when unavailable, the UI states the gate and no value movement is implied

PWA-049.scenario: Take up the separate local Garden commitment
steps: Open the test Garden's current Campaign
Open the local commitment seeded for the member
Take up the commitment with Tester B's own identity
Verify its identity differs from the protocol Request
PWA-049.expected: Tester B takes up a separate Garden-pool commitment; it is neither moved from nor mirrored to the protocol pool

PWA-050.scenario: Submit Work and evidence for the local Garden commitment
steps: Open the local Garden commitment
Start or link its Work
Add evidence that identifies the local delivery
Submit the Work
Verify the Work is linked to the local commitment
PWA-050.expected: The member's Work and evidence are submitted against the separate Garden commitment and are ready for independent review

ADM-044.scenario: Settle the Garden's contributor payout to the member
steps: Open the completed local Garden commitment's payout action
Verify Tester B is the intended contributor recipient
If contributor payout UI and value authority are available, review and submit the payout
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the receiving state
ADM-044.expected: When enabled, the Garden pays the contributing member and the result is visible; when unavailable, the UI states the gate while the completed non-value workflow remains intact

ADM-045.scenario: Queue a discretionary ProtocolToGarden treasury top-up
steps: Open the protocol treasury funding action
Choose ProtocolToGarden and identify the destination Garden
Verify no commitment ID is requested or attached
If value authority is available, review and queue the top-up
Otherwise stop at the visible gate and record Blocked
Ask Tester B to verify the Garden balance or readiness state
ADM-045.expected: When authorized and enabled, a discretionary top-up is queued for the correct Garden and its balance reflects the result; it never substitutes for earned compensation or references a commitment

service-relay.label: Service relay: Green Goods → Garden → members
service-relay.summary: Two people follow a protocol Request from the Green Goods pool through Garden delivery, then use a separate Garden commitment to recognize the member's work.

protocol-review.label: Protocol & review
protocol-review.role: Protocol steward and independent steward or evaluator of the test Garden; never a contributor

garden-member.label: Garden & member
garden-member.role: Steward and member of the test Garden; institutional claimant, accountable lead, and contributor

ADM-037.handoff: Wait until the Garden member can see the starting assessment.

ADM-038.handoff: Both people confirm the same Garden and open cycle are visible; the assessment is context, not a prerequisite.

ADM-039.handoff: Wait until the Request appears in the protocol pool for the Garden member.

PWA-047.handoff: The protocol reviewer waits for the pending Garden claim before accepting it.

ADM-040.handoff: Both people verify the Request remains in the protocol pool and names the Garden as provider.

PWA-048.handoff: The reviewer waits until the linked Work and evidence are visible before deciding.

ADM-042.handoff: Both people verify the approved Request is Fulfilled before moving to compensation.

ADM-043.handoff: The Garden member verifies the destination Garden Safe or its readiness state.
ADM-043.knownGate: Protocol-to-Garden G$ settlement requires enabled settlement UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked and continue with the non-value steps.

ADM-026.handoff: Wait until the separate local commitment appears in the open Garden Campaign.

PWA-050.handoff: The reviewer waits for the local Work and evidence before opening review.

ADM-013.handoff: Both people verify the local commitment is complete and remains distinct from the protocol Request.

ADM-044.handoff: The Garden member verifies the receiving account or the visible readiness state.
ADM-044.knownGate: Garden-to-member G$ settlement requires enabled contributor payout UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked without changing the completed non-value workflow.

protocol-treasury-top-up.label: Protocol treasury top-up
protocol-treasury-top-up.summary: Check discretionary funding readiness, queue a ProtocolToGarden top-up when authorized, and verify the Garden balance without referencing a commitment.

protocol-review.label: Protocol & review
protocol-review.role: Protocol steward with authority to inspect and, when approved, queue treasury funding

garden-member.label: Garden & member
garden-member.role: Test-Garden steward who verifies the destination Garden and its balance

ADM-045.handoff: The Garden steward verifies the destination Garden and balance; no commitment ID is involved.
ADM-045.knownGate: Protocol treasury funding requires explicit value authority and a live ProtocolToGarden funding path. If unavailable, record Blocked and do not imply that funds moved.
